method: Photon Monte Carlo (24e6 histories) in a 30 cm water cube: point source, uniform-in-solid-angle 10x10 cm pyramid at SSD 100 cm, two Co-60 lines equally weighted. Interactions sampled from XCOM water coefficients (Klein-Nishina Compton with energy-transfer sampling, Thomson-like Rayleigh, photoelectric, pair with annihilation photons). Track-length tallies in the 1 cm x 0.2 cm cylinder give fluence, interaction fractions and electron-source records. Primary fluence is analytic (exp(-mu z) with inverse-square averaged over the scoring thickness; matches MC to 0.08%). Electron fluence: continuous slowing down with restricted water collision stopping power (ESTAR minus Moller tail above 10 keV, checked against Bethe), radiative loss from ESTAR, and iterated Moller delta-ray generations above 10 keV, solved from photon-set Compton sources. Kerma = sum of fluence x E x mu_tr; D = K_col (CPE); g = K_rad/K. s_w,air uses Spencer-Attix with track-end term and Bethe-scaled air stopping power. Limitations: no explicit electron transport; L4_angular is a heuristic; L3 parent-primary spectrum estimated; PDD5 value is a literature-based estimate because the MC depth-dose tally lacked build-up and gave d_max at the surface.
data_sources: XCOM-based water photon coefficients (/tmp/data/xcom_water.txt: coherent, incoherent, photoelectric, pair nuclear+electron); ESTAR-based water electron data (/tmp/data/estar_water.txt: collision and radiative stopping powers, CSDA range, density effect); Klein-Nishina and Moller (Rohrlich-Carlson form) cross sections; Bethe formula with I_water = 75 eV and I_air = 85.7 eV for air stopping power; Z/A values water 0.55509, air 0.49919.
